verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a background-task platform. Its docs cover long-running tasks with no execution timeout, automatic retries, queues and concurrency, and recurring cron schedules. Community users independently confirm they rely on it for background jobs and that scheduled tasks 'just work', and an official MCP server lets AI assistants trigger, deploy and monitor these automations. Missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of an AI assistant setting up a recurring autonomous automation end-to-end (e.g. creating a schedule) through the MCP or skills tooling.
